properties.solubility: Sparingly soluble in water; more soluble in hot water / organics

hazardStatements: Confirm current SDS / PubChem GHS for handling
hazards.notes: CNS stimulant; dust control and potent-compound handling policies site-dependent.

overview: Caffeine is produced either by isolation from natural sources (tea, coffee, guarana) or by multi-step chemical synthesis (often via xanthine methylation). Both paradigms appear in industrial practice; plants choose based on feedstock economics and impurity profiles.
manufacturingSummary: Natural: extraction, purification, crystallization. Synthetic: methylation of xanthine intermediates with controlled methylation agents; isolation and drying to pharma/food grade.

environmentBaseline.atmosphere: Closed extraction systems preferred for VOCs

ehsHighlights: Extraction solvents: flammability and residual solvent limits
Methylating agents (synthetic routes): highly hazardous — site-specific
API dust explosion assessment for milling/finishing

routes.name: Natural extraction / purification
routes.summary: Extract caffeine from plant matrices into aqueous or organic medium; purify by crystallization and solvent recovery trains.

materials.name: Tea / coffee extract solids or liquor

steps.title: Extraction
steps.description: Contact plant material or crude extract with process solvent under controlled temperature and agitation. Separate phases; recover raffinate solids as appropriate.

steps.title: Purification and crystallization
steps.description: Concentrate extract, crystallize caffeine, wash, and dry to LOD / residual solvent targets.

scaleUp.safetyScaleUp: VOC and flammability zoning for solvent systems

sourceRefs.note: Educational scaffold — validate against primary process literature and site package

routes.name: Synthetic methylation route (literature / industrial)
routes.summary: Build or purchase xanthine core and introduce N-methyl groups under controlled conditions; workup and crystallize pure caffeine.
disadvantages: Hazardous methylating reagents; more complex EHS

steps.title: Methylation
steps.description: Charge intermediate and methylating agent under strict temperature, atmosphere, and containment controls per process package. Hold to IPC conversion.

environment.containment: High-hazard reagent handling — site OEL / PPE

steps.title: Workup, isolation, drying
steps.description: Quench residual reagent carefully; extract or crystallize; wash and dry to specification.
